explanation: Compare downloads are long format: compareGenesWorkbook writes Compare (one row per gene × population with arm n, mean and SEM), Values (one row per animal, as deposited) and Metadata sheets, with matching summary and values CSVs whose rows carry their own track provenance; the wide compareSummaryRows stays for the on-screen and compare-set tables. compareFigureExport adds chartTileExport, a per-chart PNG drawn from the chart SVG with loaded fonts inlined, and saveChartTilesZip for per-chart PNG or SVG ZIPs.
